item.title: Explore Springfield: Top attractions and must-try restaurants
item.description: Springfield, Missouri offers visitors a diverse array of attractions, including the First Friday Art Walk, Bass Pro store, Springfield Cardinals, and the Springfield Conservation Nature Center and Dickerson Park Zoo, as well as a variety of restaurants offering cuisines from around the world.

item.title: A weird look into Weird Al's 'Mandatory Fun'
item.description: Weird Al has had a successful career, from Dr. Demento to sold-out tours and viral videos, becoming the only comedy artist to debut at #1 on the Billboard 200.

item.title: Winter winds blowing back into the Ozarks
item.description: West Plains experienced record high temperatures of 75° today, while cold Canadian air will bring temperatures down to the teens by Monday morning, followed by a return to mild late winter temperatures in the 60s by mid-week.

item.description: SPRINGFIELD, Mo. — Jurassic Quest and Brick Fest Live will combine their touring shows for a three-day stop in Springfield this spring, bringing animatronic dinosaurs and LEGO-inspired building activities to the Ozark Empire Fairgrounds for one ticket price. item.title: Buffalo Police Department making progress after string of crimes
item.description: Buffalo police have quickly charged Jamal Poole with his alleged role in a break-in and damage to a business, while also investigating an arson case at Boland Automotive, and are still searching for the second suspect.
